extName.description: Extension name shown in the Chrome Web Store and toolbar. Must not contain the YouTube trademark.

extDescription.message: Interactive Thai subtitles for YouTube: word lookups, romanization, tones and known-word tracking.

statusConnecting.description: Shown while a page connects to the extension background.

statusConnected.description: Shown when the background is reachable.

statusError.description: Shown when the background cannot be reached.

sidepanelEmpty.message: Open a video with Thai subtitles to see its transcript here.

optionsSectionOnboarding.description: Options page section: onboarding of known words.

optionsSectionData.description: Options page section: data import and export.

optionsSectionAccount.description: Options page section: Sign in with ChatGPT / API key.

comingSoon.description: Placeholder for sections that are not implemented yet.

captionsLoading.description: Status while the Thai captions of a video load.

captionsNoThai.description: Status for a video without a Thai caption track; Phasa does nothing on such videos.

captionsAutoGenerated.description: Notice shown when the Thai track is YouTube's automatic speech recognition.

captionsErrorUnavailable.message: YouTube didn't return the Thai subtitles.
captionsErrorUnavailable.description: Error when YouTube answers without caption data.

captionsErrorNetwork.description: Error when the caption request fails or times out.

captionsErrorInternal.description: Error when the extension fails to parse or store captions.

settingShowTranslation.description: Toggle for the second subtitle line; T is its keyboard shortcut.

settingAutoPause.description: Toggle: pause the video at the end of every subtitle line.

sidepanelHotkeys.message: Keys: A / D previous / next line · S repeat · Space pause · T translation
sidepanelHotkeys.description: Keyboard shortcut summary in the side panel.

sidepanelReloadTab.message: Reload this YouTube tab to use Phasa here.
sidepanelReloadTab.description: Shown when the tab was opened before Phasa was installed or updated.

transcriptLabel.description: Accessible name of the transcript list in the side panel.

fontsTestTitle.description: Title of the development page that checks Thai font rendering.
